bio.summary: La Grave is an entrepreneur seeking the mayor’s office for the first time. He stresses government accountability, public safety and local economic activity.

statements.text: La Grave does not believe the language in the city’s 2026 bond measure actually guarantees replacement of several recreation centers that are mentioned in the ballot measure, since the phrase “such as” precedes the list of projects in the ballot language.
statements.speaker: Richard Valenty reporting Aquiles La Grave’s interview

statements.text: Yes the DDA was the correct tool.
statements.speaker: Aquiles La Grave
statements.source_title: Where do Boulder’s 2026 Mayorial Candidates Stand?

statements.text: Downtown requires major reinvestment and commitment in our mission to keep Downtown local.
statements.speaker: Aquiles La Grave
statements.source_title: 2026 Mayoral and City Council Candidate Questions — Aquiles La Grave

statements.text: Aquiles La Grave is a first-time candidate running for mayor on a platform of accountable government, public safety and what he calls an “unblocked” local economy. He has never held elected office and would become the first mayor to serve without having previously served on the Boulder City Council.
statements.speaker: Boulder Reporting Lab reporter

statements.text: Our city must earn back trust before it asks for more money.
statements.speaker: Aquiles La Grave

statements.text: The way you judge a government is based upon its budget and its calendar.
statements.speaker: Aquiles La Grave
statements.source_title: Where do Boulder’s 2026 Mayorial Candidates Stand?

statements.text: First, I already get the emails, because I run a business downtown, so I see who replies and who doesn't.
statements.speaker: Aquiles La Grave
statements.source_title: 2026 Mayoral and City Council Candidate Questions — Aquiles La Grave

statements.text: Yes. Our housing crisis is exporting families and billions in wages. Zoning matters, but permit times make the difference on what gets built.
statements.speaker: Aquiles La Grave
statements.source_title: Where do Boulder’s 2026 Mayorial Candidates Stand?

statements.text: Let's stop pretending and say the quiet part aloud.
statements.speaker: Aquiles La Grave
statements.source_title: 2026 Mayoral and City Council Candidate Questions — Aquiles La Grave

statements.text: Yes, and we must enhance design to ensure public safety in all circumstances especially rapid fire evacuation across the system.
statements.speaker: Aquiles La Grave
statements.source_title: Where do Boulder’s 2026 Mayorial Candidates Stand?
